name: Site operating cash matches posted receipts and a Site A payment does not leak into Site B
title: SC-13-25-06 Site operating cash matches posted receipts and a Site A payment does not leak into Site B
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the journey sites exist with 0.00 cash
When Site B cash is captured immediately before and after a Site A payment
Then Site B cash is unchanged and Site A cash grows by exactly the payment
And at each checkpoint both sites' posted operating cash equals the independent reconciliation
